statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-1757 is a memory leak in the interactive shell of xmllint (xmllint --shell): a line consisting only of whitespace skips command execution without freeing the input buffer, so repeating it exhausts memory and ends the process. Upstream fixed it in https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2/-/issues/1009 (commits https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2/-/commit/160c8a43ba37dfb07ebe6446fbad9d0973d9279d and https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2/-/commit/5446460ad3229579c91506317fb80ab333d44414), and Debian fixed trixie in 2.12.7+dfsg+really2.9.14-2.1+deb13u3 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-1757). This owner rebuilds Debian's trixie libxml2 source. Its only published build in the DHI Debian repository, for amd64 and arm64, is built from Debian 2.12.7+dfsg+really2.9.14-2.1+deb13u3, and the package changelog it ships includes Debian's entry for that version, which lists the fix for CVE-2026-1757. Earlier builds of Debian 2.12.7+dfsg+really2.9.14-2.1+deb13u2 are no longer published. Earlier builds of Debian 2.12.7+dfsg+really2.9.14-2.1+deb13u3, also no longer published, already carried Debian's fix but sort below the end of this range, so they read as affected. The range ends at the published build of 2.12.7+dfsg+really2.9.14-2.1+deb13u3.
